why: In every row the black part of the circle grows by the same step from left to right. Row 3 must start with less black than its middle circle. Option 1 (three-quarters black, a white quarter) is one step before the middle circle, so it fits. Option 2 is exactly the same as the middle circle, so the row would not grow, and option 3 (half black) is too small for row 3.
trick: Each circle in a row gets a little more black than the one before it.
